This is a lesson for starters who have just got interested in learning Korean and for learners who find it difficult to understand the basic rules of Korean grammar regardless of their levels.

This lesson will include Speaking(Main Focus), Basic Structures(Grammar), Reading, Writing, and Vocabulary. pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description:
For intermediate to advanced students:
In this lesson, I will guide you with series of questions to make you think and put those thoughts into words. I'll provide feedback to correct some common mistakes and make your words more diverse. For example, it's natural to use filler words like "Um", "Ah", even "So", but it's better to avoid being repetitive or redundant (except to stress a key point). We'll practice, practice, and practice. At times you may feel unnatural, like it's not your voice. However, slowly but surely, you'll become a better conversation partner, even an eloquent speaker. 

For beginners:
Don't worry if you can't find the words to express yourself. In the beginning, I'll avoid asking open-ended questions (5W+1H questions: who, what, when, where, why, how). Instead, I'll be asking more yes/no questions until you become comfortable. When you're ready, you can ask me questions! By the way, I do fluent speak Korean and Mandarin Chinese.

Vocabulary enhancement:
- Increase your vocabulary using mnemonics (synonyms, rhymes, and pictures.
- Systematically review the words using spaced repetition

teacher_info.introduction: I have a bachelor’s degree in Engineering. Also, I have an International Trade Professional certificate so I can also teach you professional Korean for business. If you are interested in translation, I have qualifications in both interpretation and translation so I can help you with that as well. For absolute beginners, you will learn how the Korean alphabet (한글) works. I will help you master the Korean alphabet and you will feel comfortable without using romanization when reading Korean. After that, we can move on to the next level. For beginners: We will start by reading short sentences while focusing on proper pronunciation for each word, as well as fully understanding the vocabulary in each sentence. Also, we will spend time on reading and writing short sentences to study and practice grammar. Once you feel comfortable reading, we are going to move on to advanced content. before you know it, you will be able to carry out a daily conversation easily! For intermediate learners: While working on more complex grammar structures with high level vocabulary, we can increase your conversation fluency in Korean as well. Also, we will begin to incorporate news articles and other materials into your reading practice. For advanced learners: You will work on understanding and responding to complex sentences with accuracy while maintaining natural pronunciation. We can actively use media materials such as Korean dramas, news, etc. that fit your interests, academic studies, or job requirements. If you are interested in translation, suitable materials will be prepared and we and we can work on developing your translation skill as well. For all learners from absolute beginners to advanced learners, our lessons will be designed to fit your personal goal. If you already have a Korean textbook or study plan that you have been working on, we can start from there, if not I will recommend suitable materials in addition to the ones we cover in class. See you soon!
